orderId.description: OrderID is the numeric Shopify order ID.

factories.name: newListOrdersStep
factories.description: List one page of Shopify orders across all order statuses, subject to Shopify's order history access.

inputSchema.description: ListOrdersInput selects one bounded page of Shopify orders.

attributionAppId.description: AttributionAppID filters orders attributed to this numeric app ID or "current".

createdAtMax.description: CreatedAtMax filters orders created on or before an RFC3339 timestamp.

createdAtMin.description: CreatedAtMin filters orders created on or after an RFC3339 timestamp.

financialStatus.description: FinancialStatus filters by Shopify's order financial status; blank omits the filter.

fulfillmentStatus.description: FulfillmentStatus filters by Shopify's order fulfillment status; blank omits the filter.

ids.description: IDs selects a comma-separated list of numeric Shopify order IDs.

limit.description: Limit bounds one page from 1 through 250; zero uses Shopify default.

pageInfo.description: PageInfo is the opaque cursor returned by a previous listOrders page.

processedAtMax.description: ProcessedAtMax filters orders processed on or before an RFC3339 timestamp.

processedAtMin.description: ProcessedAtMin filters orders processed on or after an RFC3339 timestamp.

sinceId.description: SinceID selects orders after a numeric Shopify order ID.

status.description: Status filters open, closed, cancelled, or any orders; blank means any.

updatedAtMax.description: UpdatedAtMax filters orders updated on or before an RFC3339 timestamp.

updatedAtMin.description: UpdatedAtMin filters orders updated on or after an RFC3339 timestamp.
